messages:
Rina Desai: Quick proposal: tighten postmortem follow-ups. Small parseable remediation block + automated checkpoints. SLA enforcement for misses. Thoughts?

Tom Nguyen: +1. Keep it tiny so bots can parse. Suggest fields: owner, due, failure_mode, regression_check, checkpoints.

Elijah Ford: Also require a \"prevented_by\" field so we know the intended guardrail. For IC rotation, recommend 1-week shifts and a one-line handoff doc.

Rina Desai: Draft block (paste into PM or Jira comment):
```
remediation: short summary
owner: Name (team)
due: YYYY-MM-DD
failure_mode: [cache, auth, db]
prevented_by: brief guard
regression_check: smoke-url-or-id
checkpoints: 36h, 3d, 21d
pm_link: url
```

Tom Nguyen: Sounds good. ops-bot can ping owner at 36h and escalate at 72h to tech lead. Auto-create follow-up card if 21d regression check absent.

Elijah Ford: For comms cadence: initial, 30m, hourly until stable, final. IC picks cadence on declare. Keep updates <=2 lines and link timeline.

ops-bot: Checkpoint scheduled: REM-2024-889 36h reminder to Rina Desai will post in #eng-oncall at 3080014745.

Rina Desai: Action items: Tom -> prototype parser and reminders (due 7 days). Elijah -> handoff one-pager (due 3 days). I'll add the block to current PM today.

Tom Nguyen: Confirmed, will start.

Elijah Ford: Confirmed.
